lines.text: الجلوس والوقوف من كرسي (الجانبين). قف من الكرسي دون استخدام يديك، ثم اجلس ببطء. 3 × 10، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Sit-to-stand from a chair (both sides). Stand up from a chair without using your hands, then sit down slowly. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Sitting and standing from a chair (both sides). Stand from the chair without using your hands, then sit slowly. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: تقويم الركبة جالسًا مع شريط (اليمين). اجلس على كرسي والشريط حول الكاحل، ثم قوّم الركبة ببطء. 3 × 12، كل يومين. زفر الهواء عند تقويم الركبة.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every other day. Breathe out as you straighten the knee.
lines.back_translation: Knee straightening seated with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle, then straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every two days. Exhale the air when straightening the knee.

lines.text: صعود الدرج (اليمين). ارفع قدمك اليمنى إلى الدرج السفلي ثم انزل. 2 × 10، كل يوم. امسك درابزين الدرج دائمًا أثناء القيام بذلك.
lines.source_en: Step-up (right). Step up onto the bottom stair leading with your right leg, then step down. 2 × 10, every day. Always hold the stair rail when you do it.
lines.back_translation: Ascend the stairs (right). Raise your right foot to the lower stair, then descend. 2 x 10, every day. Always hold the stair railing while doing this.

lines.text: المشي. امشِ بسرعة مريحة. 20 دقيقة، 5 أيام في الأسبوع. بعض ألم الركض أثناء المشي مقبول إذا زال بحلول الصباح التالي.
lines.source_en: Walking. Walk at a comfortable pace. 20 minutes, 5 days a week. Some knee pain while walking is acceptable if it has settled by the next morning.
lines.back_translation: Walking. Walk at a comfortable speed. 20 minutes, 5 days in the week. Some pain of the knee during walking is acceptable if it has disappeared by the next morning.

lines.text: تمدد الساق الخلفي ضد الحائط (اليمين). انحنِ ضد الحائط مع ساقك اليمنى خلفك، كعبك على الأرض، واحتفظ. 3 × 30 ثانية، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Calf stretch against a wall (right). Lean against a wall with your right leg behind you, heel down, and hold. 3 × 30 seconds, every day.
lines.back_translation: Stretching the back of the leg against the wall (right). Lean against the wall with your right leg behind you, heel on the ground, and hold.

raised.detail: the therapist said: Always hold the stair rail when you do it.
